name: karo
description: Karo - a modern, customisable terminal for SwirlOS: themes, tabs, command palette, live settings, autosuggest.
author: Swirl
title: Karo
tagline: A modern terminal with themes, tabs and a command palette.
long:
Karo is a modern terminal for SwirlOS. It runs every command of the stock terminal (the JSON commands in /system/gterm) and adds a lot on top.
Look: 10 built-in themes (Karo Night, Midnight, Nord, Dracula, Gruvbox, Mocha, Solar Dark, Paper, Swirl, Terminal), your own themes as simple .conf files, powerline / minimal / classic prompts, pill or line tabs, block / bar / underline cursor, adjustable font size, line spacing and padding, and a status bar.
Feel: tabs, a command palette (Ctrl+P), a live settings panel (Ctrl+O), history autosuggest, Tab completion, ANSI colour output, mouse selection and copy, aliases that persist, and a resizable grid.
Everything is saved to /home/user/.config/karo/karo.conf.
Keys: Ctrl+T/W new/close tab, Ctrl+N/B next/previous tab, Ctrl+P palette, Ctrl+O settings, Ctrl+L clear, Ctrl+C copy or stop, Ctrl+V paste.
